headline: The backend now follows one set of conventions for errors, access checks, events, reads, limits and endpoint layout, with no change to what users see.

presumed.what: Read the owner's pause directive d3 as fulfilled after the restart and resumed at step 17.
presumed.why: The directive asked for a pause for a machine restart and named a later launch resuming from the next step.

presumed.what: Solo fix 1 turned off parallel running of the integration test classes (one test-config file) to stop a host-start race.
presumed.why: The race is in FastEndpoints' process-wide JSON options and pre-dates F38; the owner's no-new-tests rule is read as not covering test configuration. Integration project now takes ~45–100 s longer.

pluginFindings.finding: verify-run's output excerpt cut off the exception message of a failing .NET test, so the cause could only be found by re-running with a TRX logger.
verify-run --files cannot target a single .NET test file, so every by-name re-run became a whole-project or complete run.
